Race Registration Launch Timeline
Race Registration Launch Timeline
July–September 2026 Races
Please note all information is subject to change.
July–September 2026 races will open for registration at 12:00 p.m. ET on the following dates:
Tuesday, May 5: Advance registration for adult races opens for members at the Member Plus and above levels.
NYRR Grete's Great Gallop 10K, New Balance 5th Avenue Mile, and the New Balance Bronx 10 Mile open for all members.
General registration open to the public for youth events.
Thursday, May 7: General registration opens to the public for adult races.
Read about the non-9+1 race entry registration pilot here.
Learn more about NYRR Membership.
